s: klI, (ni + Bala + Ric + BAve lyuw .) darSanam । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ ni + cu--Bala--nirUpaRe BAve lyuw । darSane trikA॰ ।
m: नि-˚भालन n. seeing, perception, L. (w.r. नि-फ्˚).

s: tri, (ni + BU + kta .) atItam । BUtakAlaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: tri॰ niScalaM BUtaH । atyantaBIte rAjani॰ । atyantaBayena hi niSvalaM BavatIti tasya taTAtvam ।
m: नि-भूत mfn. (√ भू) past, gone, L.
quite frightened, A.
a: निभूत — a. 1 Quite frightened(अ त्यंतभीत). --2 Gone, past.

v: pu॰ niBUya nitarAM BUtvA matsyAdirUpeRAvatIryya pAti pA--ka । vizRO “vizRave niBUyapAya svAhA” vaju॰ 22 । 20 ।
m: निभूयप (?) m. N. of Viṣṇu, VS.

s: tri, (niyataM BAtIti । ni + BA + ka .) sadfSaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 38 ॥ (yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 10 । 9 । “prabudDapuRqarIkAkzaM bAlAtapaniBAMSukam । divasaM SAradamiva prAramBasuKadarSanam ॥”) prakASaH । vyAje, puM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: tri॰ ni + BA--ka । 1 nitarAM BAsamAne 2 sadfSe ca sAdfSye'sya nityasa॰ na pfTak prayogaH । “praPullatApiYCaniBEraBIzuBiH” “muKena pUrRenQuniBastrilocanA” mAGaH “prakftyanyo niBAdyanTaH sa vA pratyasa ucyate” SabdaSa॰ ।
m: नि-भ mf(आ)n. (√ भा) resembling, like, similar (ifc.), MBh.; R. &c. (sometimes pleonast. after adj., e.g. चारु-निभानन, ‘handsome-faced’, Hariv., or comp. with a synonym, e.g. नग-निभोपम, ‘mountain-like’, MBh.; पद्म-पत्त्राभ-निभ, ‘like a lotus-leaf’, ib.)
नि-भ m. or n. appearance, pretext (only ifc. instr. Daś.; abl. Kathās.).
a: निभ — [नि-भा-क] (At the end of comp. only) Like, similar, resembling; उदबुद्धमुग्धकनकाब्जनिभं वहंती Māl. 1. 40; so चंद्रनिभानना &c. --भः, --भं 1 Appearance, light, manifestation. --2 Pretence, disguise, pretext. --3 A trick, fraud.

m: नि-√ भञ्ज् P. -भनक्ति (aor. न्य्-अभाङ्क्षीत्), to break or dash to pieces, Bhaṭṭ.
नि-˚भञ्जन n. breaking to pieces or asunder, AV.
नि-√ भल् P. Ā. -भालयति, ˚ते, to perceive, see, ChUp.; Bālar.
a: निभल् — {c10c} U. To see, behold, perceive, look at; निभाल्य भूयो निजगौरिमाणं मा नाम मानं सहसैव यासीः Bv. 2. 176; or यन्मां न भामिनि निभालयसि प्रभातनीलारविंदमदभांगिपदैः कटाक्षैः 3. 4.

m: नि-भर्त्सन, नि-भर्˚त्सयत्, w.r. for निर्-भ्˚.
नि-भसद् mfn. (prob.) having the hinder parts directed downwards, TāṇḍyaBr.
नि-भ—ता f. similarity, likeness, RPrāt.
नि-भृता (आ), f. a kind of riddle, Kāvyād.
निभृताचार mfn. of resolute conduct, firm, R.
निभृतागत mfn. secretly arrived, ib.
निभृतार्थ mfn. having a secret meaning, occult, Śiś.
निभृतात्मन् mfn. resolute-minded, resolute, BhP.
निभृती-√ कृ to keep quiet or unmoved, Kāv.

s: tri, (ni + Bf + kta .) vinItaH । nirjanaH । yaTA, -- “niBftanikuYjagfhaM gatayA niSi rahasi nilIya vasantam .” iti SrIjayadevaH । 2 । 11 ॥ (astamayAsannaH । yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 8 । 15 । “naBasA niBftendunA tulAmuditArkeRa samAruroha tat ॥”)
v: tri॰ ni + Bf--kta । 1 Dfte 2 vinIte 3 nilale 4 ekAgre 5 gupte 6 nirjane astAyopasTite ca SarbdArTaci॰ “namasA niBftendunA tulAm” raGuH “maDukarANganayA muhurunmadaDyaniBftA niBftAkzaramujjame” mAGaH ।
m: नि-भृत mfn. (√ भृ) borne or placed down, hidden, secret, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
nearly set (as the moon), Ragh.
firm, immovable, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.
shut, closed (as a door), L.
fixed, settled, decided, RV.
fixed or intent upon (comp.), Kād.
filled with, full of (instr. or comp.), BhP.
attached, faithful, MBh.; MārkP.
still, silent, Kum.
quiet, humble, modest, mild, gentle, MBh.; R. &c.
free from passions, undisturbed (= शान्त), Hcar.
lonely, solitary, Gīt.
नि-भृत n. humility, modesty, MBh. v, 1493 (Nīlak. ‘secrecy, silence’).
a: निभृत — a. 1 Placed down, deposited, lowered. --2 Filled with, full of; चिंतया निभृतः Bhāg. --3 Concealed, hidden, out of sight, unperceved, unobserved; निभृतो भूत्वा Pt. 1; नभसा निभृतेंदुना R. 8. 15 ‘with the moon become invisible, about to set or go down’; Ve. 6. 2, Śi. 6. 20. --4 Secret, covert; Śi. 13. 42. --5 (a) Still, silent; निभृतद्विरेफं ( काननं) Ku. 3. 42, 6. 2. (b) Steady, fixed, immovable, motionless; Ś. 1. 8. --6 Mild, gentle; अनिभृता वायवः Ki. 13. 66 ‘not gentle, violent or strong’; Māl. 2. 12; Mv. 3. 14. --7 Modest, humble; अनिभृतकरेषु प्रियेषु Me. 68; प्रणामनिभृता कुलवधूरिव Mu. 1. --8 Firm, resolute. --9 Lonely, solitary; निभृतनिकुंजगृहं गतया Gīt. 2. --10 Shut, closed (as a door). --11 True, faithful, firmly attached. --तं Modesty, humility. --तं ind. 1 Secretly, covertly, privatly, unperceived; Ś. 3; Śi. 3. 74; Ms. 9. 263. --2 Silently, quietly; K. 134. --3 Out of sight, in a corner. --Comp. --आत्मन् a. firm, resolute.

k.v: वश्यः प्रणेयो निभृतविनीतप्रश्रिताः समाः। धृष्टे धृष्णग्वियातश्च प्रगल्भः प्रतिभान्विते॥

m: नि-भृतम् (अम्), ind. secretly, privately, silently, quietly, Mn.; Kāv.; Pañc. &c.
नि-भृत—स्थित mfn. standing out of sight, unperceived, Kathās.
निभृतोर्ध्व-कर्ण mfn. having the ears fixed and erect (said of horses), Śak. i, 8.
नि-˚भृष्ट See अ-निभृ˚.
नि-√ भिद् (Pass. -भिद्यते), to be opened, open, BhP. (v.l. अनु-भ्˚).
नि-√ भ्रंश् Caus. -भ्राशयति, to cause to fall, strike down, fell, RV. x, 116, 5.
नि-√ 1. भुज् P. -भुजति, to bend (head and knees), Pat.
